1. Initial materials 
• Assigment from the machine producer PTV, spol. s r.o. 
2. Range of eectro-project 
The subject of the project is not a solution of the internal wiring of separate functional complexes 
embedded in the electric-cabinets. The units are wired in as functional blocks with their proper individual 
documentation. The project resolves only the provision of the power supply by the protected supplies for 
these units and their external hardware treatment. 
• Internal wiring of the control cabinet water jet cutting machine. 
• Internal wiring of the panel control cabinet. 
• Specification of the separate location units inside of the cabinet. 
• Interconnection of boxes with sensors and action elements. 
3. The power-supply system 
• The power-supply voltage system: 
TN-S, 3+N+PE-400/230V, 50-60Hz 
(The alternatively supplying power-supply voltage system:TN-C, 3+PEN -400/230V, 50-60Hz) 
• Maximum bars short-circuit current: 
10kA 
• Installed power consumption of the machine: 
5,5kW  
• Recommended machine supply protection by means of the 25A/B circuit breaker or the PN 000 Gg 25A 
fuse  
• Size of the supply cable: 5x2,5mm2.  
• As the machine does not include protection against overvoltage, it is necessary to protect the machine 
supply against overvoltage by the over-voltage protection of the 2nd degree. 
• The project does not resolve compensation of the cosφ individually for this device. The device has the 
cosφ better than 0,85 and its compensation will be resolved centrally. 
4. Protection against the dangerous touch voltage 
The protection against the dangerous touch voltage is performed in accordance with EN 60204-1 art. 6.3.1, 
CSN 322000-4-41 (IEC 364-4-41) and the continuing ones. In the TN-C-S, 3+N+PE - 400/230V system the 
protection is performed by automatic disconnection of the circuits from the power-supply. This protection is 
extended with the supplementary protection by means of inclusion of the current protector as well as the 
supplementary protection by means of earthing, if you like the protective connection. 
The parts of the distributor, which remain under voltage also when the main switch is turned off must be 
labeled visibly in accordance with 5036 IEC60417-1 – the black lightning on the yellow background inside 
of the black triangle – in the final arrangement in correspondence with the B.3.6 ISO 3864 label, with the 
minimum IP20 degree of protection – prevention from finger-touching. As the complex inner enclosure of 
the distributor does not satisfy the IP20 requirement after door opening, it is necessary to put an alert label 
on the distributor door in accordance with 5036  IEC60417-1 - the black lightning on the yellow background 
inside of the black triangle, if need be added by the text "Attention, electric device!" 
5. Circuits of the emergency stop 
Every protective component connected with the emergency-stop circuit, i.e. the buttons, limit switches etc., 
must satisfy the requirements given by CSN EN 60204-1 art. 10.7 and the continuing norm of CSN EN 418 
(EN 418), chapter 4, i.e.. the mechanical installation of all components must be performed, in terms of 
construction, so the requirement of the enforced switch-off is satisfied (normally the component is not 
strained mechanically). 
6. Environment in accordance with CSN 
• The distributor is determined for standard environment in accordance with CSN 60204-1 art.4.4. 
• Limitation of the outer temperature from +5°C to +30°C, the biggest change of the temperature in 30 
min. 10°C max. 
• Relative air humidity between 30% and 90%.

• The atmospheric pressure from 84 to 107 kPa. The device must work reliably up to 1000m above the 
sea level. 
• Dustiness of the environment: 20mg/m3 max. Size of the particles: 10µm max. 
• Climatic resistance in accordance with CSN IEC 721-2-1 is WT (moderate climate) 
7. Warehousing conditions 
• Temperature of the environment from -25°C to +55°C 
• Relative humidity from 30% to 95% at 30°C. 
• Environment without aggressive gases and steams, dry and enclosed, protected against weather 
effects, humidity, dustiness and mechanical damage. 
8. Transportation 
• It must be performed in enclosed means of transport. 
• The distributor must not be exposed to the effects of both rain and snow. 
• The location in a transport means must be provided so damage of the distributor is impossible to come 
about. The transportation conditions are identical to the warehousing conditions. 
• Permissible cyclical beats during transportation may reach 10g max. at the impulse length of 5-10ms. 
 
The producer is not responsible for damage caused along transportation because of transporter’s fault. 
9. Technical description of the equipment 
• The switchboard box is made of steel plates with protection IP54 according to ČSN EN 60529 (IEC 
529), i.e. protection against dust is not fully covered, the dust cannot influence the equipment 
operation, however.  
• The protection against the water spouted on the cover does not influence the equipment operation a 
negative way.    
• The project processing is intended for the indoor location of cutting machine switchboard boxes.  
• The button controllers and signal lamps are located on the front board of the main switchboard.  
• The main switch is situated on the main switch board. If necessary, it is possible to lock the main switch 
when it is in „switch off“ position. 
10. Distributor measurement 
• Insulation resistance – according to CSN EN 60 204-1 art.19.3 it is measured on the points which are 
galvanic-connected with the line voltage. The measured resistance of the points which are 
galvanic-connected with the line voltage must be more than 1MΩ. 
• Dielectric strenght – according to CSN EN 60 204-1 art.19.4 it is tested immediately after measuring the 
insulation resistance on the same testing points, with the testing voltage of 1000V. 
• Contact resistance – according to CSN EN 60 204-1 art.19.2 it is tested between the input terminal of 
the protective conductor and the places, on which the dangerous touch voltage could appear as a 
consequence of isolation defect. The measured value must not exceed the voltage of 1V at the current 
of 10A, 50Hz for the duration of at least 10s. 
• Residual current circuit breaker: Measurement of the effectiveness of protection by means of the 
residual current circuit breaker. 
11. Attendance and maintenance 
• Attendance is described in the attendance manual, which is a separate document and is not a part of 
the electro-project. 
• Maintenance The distributor is an electric device which requires qualified-personnel maintenance. The 
basic maintenance consists in the supply voltage check-up and device sight check, test of the residual 
current circuit breaker functioning by means of the function-test button (each month, others done in the 
6-month intervals). During the maintenance terminals are tightened and the line voltage of 400V AC 
and 24V DC is subject to check-up. 
As it is dealt with maintenance of the electric device it is necessary to follow valid precautionary 
prescripts.

Especially: 
• The distributor must be located out of the working space of another machine as well as the machines 
working nearby. The access of the distributor attendance must be provided so it does not interfere with 
the working space of the machine or other machines. 
• After switching off the main switch the voltage remains only on the input terminals of the distributor and 
the main switch. These devices must be labeled visibly in accordance with 417  IEC5036 – the black 
lightning on the yellow background inside of the black triangle in the final arrangement in 
correspondence with the 113ISO3864 label, with the minimum IP2x degree of protection – prevention 
from finger-touching. 
 
Montage, repairs and maintenance of the distributor can only be performed by qualified personnel 
 
12. Hygiene and working precautions 
From the working safeness and health protection at work point of view, it is not necessary to make other 
precautions than those presented by CSN. 
13. Prescripts and norms 
The product satisfies the requirements of the CSN EN 60204-1:2000 norm, in which IEC204-1:1992 part 1 
for electric devices of the working machines and associated norms are worked out.
